name: Single-Leg Balance Stand

rehabilitation.clinical_protocol: APTA Ankle Sprain Clinical Practice Guidelines

steps: Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart near a sturdy surface or wall.
Shift your weight onto your left foot, keeping your standing knee soft and unlocked.
Lift your right foot off the floor, bending the right knee to roughly 90 degrees.
Keep your hips level and gaze focused on a stable point straight ahead.
Hold for 15 to 30 seconds, then gently lower your foot and repeat on the right leg.
coaching_cues: Keep your standing foot firmly rooted with equal pressure across your big toe, pinky toe, and heel.
Keep a light fingertip on the wall if you feel unsteady.
To increase difficulty as you advance, try crossing your arms over your chest or closing your eyes.
